messages:
Marta (CS): FYI - VelaHealth onboarding flagged for potential renewal risk if we can’t close the latency SLO gaps by next week. Customer asked for a formal credit calc and evidence bundle.
Devon (SRE): Got the alert. We saw 95th p50 blips last Friday during warmup, looks like KV cache missed on burst.
Alex (Account): Customer is worried about churn, said they’ll escalate to procurement if we can’t show mitigation plan + credits. Need crisp comms.
Marta (CS): Can SRE confirm scope of impacted windows and whether this meets the SLA credit threshold? I need numbers for the customer-facing note.
Devon (SRE): Quick summary: 3 incidents between 03:10-03:45 UTC, 120s median tail latency for affected routes. We’re pulling traces now. If these meet the < 99.9% uptime bucket in account contract, credit = pro rata for window.
Priya (Enablement): I can assemble an enablement note and a one-pager for customer ops showing our remediation steps and runbook. Do you want a dry-run internal review before we send? :+1:
Marta (CS): Yes please. Also include the warmup mitigation we rolled out (auto-prefix cache + reduced batch window) and the timeline of rollout.
Devon (SRE): Evidence snippets:
```
TRACE 03:12:08 route=/text-gen latency=1200ms cache_hit=false kernel=fp16
TRACE 03:15:02 route=/embed latency=980ms cache_hit=false kernel=int8
```
Devon (SRE): Will export traces and uptime calc by EOD. If the uptime for the month drops below SLA threshold we draft the credit amount.
Marta (CS): Alex, can you set expectation with the CSM that we’ll share a formal credit calc + remediation note tomorrow EOD and offer a joint runbook walk-through next week?
Alex (Account): On it. I’ll tell them we’ll share numbers tomorrow and schedule a 30-min call for Tuesday.
Priya (Enablement): Drafting the walkthrough slide deck and checklist now. Will post a link here when ready.
OpsBot: Incident report created: IR-2026-552345 - assigned to Devon (SRE).
Marta (CS): Thanks team. Action items: SRE -> export uptime calc + traces, Enablement -> draft comms + deck, CS/Account -> customer note + call invite. I’ll collate the evidence bundle for credits.
Devon (SRE): Noted. Also recommending we add a short-term canary to the warmup path to prevent KV miss on sudden bursts.
Marta (CS): Great — include that as part of remediation and timeline in the note. Closing loop in this thread once evidence bundle uploaded. :blush:
